title: Reverberator
text: 为音频信号添加混响，输入 7 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；{Pre-delay (s)} 指定混响预延迟、{Highcut frequency (Hz)} 指定低通滤波器截止频率、{Diffusion} 指定混响尾音密度、{Decay factor} 指定混响尾音衰减因子、{High frequency damping} 指定高频阻尼、{Wet/dry mix} 指定湿、{Inherit sample rate from input} 指定输入采样率的来源、{Input sample rate (Hz)} 指定输入的采样率、{Simulate using} 指定要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: Delay
ports.summary: 混响预延迟 (s) scalar in the range [0,1]

ports.name: HighCut
ports.summary: 低通滤波器截止频率 positive scalar in the range [0, (Sample Rate)/2]

ports.name: Diffusion
ports.summary: 混响尾音密度 scalar in the range [0,1]

ports.name: Decay
ports.summary: 混响尾音衰减因子 scalar in the range [0,1]

ports.name: Damping
ports.summary: 高频阻尼 scalar in the range [0,1]

ports.name: WetDry
ports.summary: 湿（混响）信号与干（原始）信号之比 scalar in the range [0,1]

params.name: Pre-delay (s)
params.values: 混响预延迟 0 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Highcut frequency (Hz)
params.values: 低通滤波器截止频率 20000 (default) | scalar in the range [0, (Sample Rate)/2]

params.name: Diffusion
params.values: 混响尾音密度 0.50 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Decay factor
params.values: 混响尾音衰减因子 0.50 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: High frequency damping
params.values: 高频阻尼 0.0005 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Wet/dry mix
params.values: 湿（混响）信号与干（原始）信号之比 0.3 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Inherit sample rate from input
params.values: 指定输入采样率的来源 on (default) | off

params.name: Input sample rate (Hz)
params.values: 输入的采样率 44100 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 指定要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
